[anthropic-claude-opus-4-8-other-3] Three teams differ only in which benchmark is scored, HarmBench, JailbreakBench or StrongREJECT, and each team runs eight AARs against Phi-4-mini with the capability and over-refusal gates unchanged.
[anthropic-claude-opus-4-8-other-3] Every team climbs the benchmark it is scored on, and the median AAR’s best method closes 69.3%, 24.2% and 79.2% of the headroom on HarmBench, JailbreakBench and StrongREJECT respectively.
[anthropic-claude-opus-4-8-other-3] On HarmBench and StrongREJECT the methods the over-refusal gate rejects close far more headroom on the climbed benchmark than the methods it accepts, 80.1% against 28.6% and 95.2% against 43.1%, with benign compliance falling as low as 0.06 against a floor of 0.58.
